correctness.rationale: Expand cubic self-ambiguity to an imprimitive quadratic Gauss sum. For each k!=0, t=v_p(k), C(k,l)=0 iff p^t does not divide l; nonzero modulus p^((a+t)/2). Perturbation contributes epsilon*omega^(-k^3)*(1+omega^(lk)); nonzero Gauss values dominate 2epsilon since p>=5,a>=2, while zeros have minimum 2epsilon sin(pi/(2p^(a-1))), attained at k=p, l=(p^(a-1)±1)/2. Normalize by N+2epsilon+epsilon². Weyl conjugation diagonalizes the full N²×N² complex-linear lifting with singular values sqrt(N)|A_g|; a valuation census gives unperturbed rank (pN²+1)/(p+1), and derivative proves epsilon=1 best within (0,1]. Independent direct DFT checks at N=25 (epsilon 0.4) and N=49 (epsilon 1) reproduced exact minima/ranks; only proof handles all p,a.
